**In one line**: OpenAI has reportedly introduced a new model named Astra, described as its most intelligent to date, with cybersecurity positioned as a central selling point.

### Key points
- OpenAI is said to have unveiled Astra, pitching it as the "world's most intelligent model."
- The launch reportedly leads with **cybersecurity** as a headline feature rather than raw capability alone.
- Detailed specs, pricing, and availability still warrant confirmation beyond this initial report.

### Why it matters
The framing signals that frontier-model competition is broadening from "smarter" to "safer." Foregrounding security suggests OpenAI is courting enterprise buyers who weigh data leakage and misuse risk first — a pitch that could become a standard part of how major models are announced.
